## Where Kokonut UI stops short

 React and Next.js only, no Vue or vanilla HTML/CSS/JS output
 Runs on Motion, not GSAP, so there's no timeline sequencing, ScrollTrigger-style scroll control, or SVG/MotionPath tooling built in
 CLI install has shipped real friction: multiple GitHub issues report the `npx shadcn add` command aborting with an "unsafe file path" registry error, and one issue notes the copy-paste install command pointed at the wrong URL
 Components come from an open community catalog rather than commissioned client work, so depth and polish vary component to component
 The Pro tier is a fixed one-time catalog, not an ongoing production system, there's no equivalent of a documented, uniform tuning contract across every component

Limitations as of September 2026. [...] ## What Kokonut UI does well

 Free and MIT-licensed core catalog, no cost to try or ship
 Install through the shadcn CLI, so it drops straight into an existing shadcn/ui project
 Backed by Vercel's OSS program, active repo with recent commits
 One-time lifetime price on Pro instead of a subscription, if you want the premium set
 AI-agent-friendly registry (works with the shadcn CLI's machine-readable format), useful if you're generating UI with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools
 Broad spread of ready-made sections (pricing tables, hero blocks, AI input variants) on top of individual components

:   free and open-source (MIT license), plus Kokonut UI Pro at a one-time lifetime price around $99-159 (site has run promo pricing as low as $99-119) for 100+ premium components and 7-8 templates, as of 2026-09

GitHub

Kokonut UI is an open-source collection of React and Next.js components built on Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Motion (formerly Framer Motion). Components install through the shadcn CLI or by copying the source directly, and a paid Pro tier adds a second set of premium components and templates on top of the free catalog.

Kokonut UI: AI components that feel right

# Kokonut UI

Open-source React components for AI apps, and the inputs, cards and buttons around them.  
 100+ components built with Tailwind CSS, Motion and shadcn/ui. Your agent or the shadcn CLI installs them, and they live in your codebase.

Docs · Changelog · Agents · Pro

Kokonut UI - Open-source UI components for your AI agent | Product Hunt

## Quick start

Kokonut UI is a shadcn/ui registry. Add the namespace to your `components.json`:

```
"registries" "@kokonutui"" " "
```

Then add any component by name:

```
npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/ai-tool-approval
```

```
import AIToolApproval from"@/components/kokonutui/ai-tool-approval"; export default function Page(){return< AIToolApproval/>;}
``` [...] Every component has a live demo, its source, and the packages it installs on its docs page. New ones land in the changelog.

## Use with AI agents

Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex can search and install Kokonut UI components through the shadcn MCP server. The Agents page has the one-line setup for each editor and a rules file to drop in. The docs are also available as plain text at kokonutui.com/llms.txt.

## Kokonut UI Pro

Kokonut UI Pro adds premium components, blocks and full Next.js templates. Pro components install through the same shadcn CLI.
